Group profile / 01MD–ORG / 2026

An organization
without fixed limits.

The name was conceived before the business. The organization became a home for the work that followed.

01 / Operating statement

A structure for unlike things.

Mathim Divisions is an independent umbrella for research, systems work, writing, and creative initiatives. It provides continuity without insisting that every project share a market, audience, or discipline.

Some of this work is practical: audits, documentation, tools, and operational systems. Some is experimental: research into useful intelligence and how constrained systems behave. And some is simply worth making.

Mathim exists to give each of those efforts a home.

02 / Historical note

The name came first.

Mathim Divisions began as an imaginary company invented by Cassie and her childhood friend Cameron, known as Weasel. It could be responsible for any imagined business or product. That was the entire advantage.

Years later, Cassie asked Cameron whether she could use the name for a real company. He agreed. The original idea has endured: a name wide enough to leave room for whatever comes next.

Mathim's broad remit is real. The shadow-conglomerate presentation is an intentional creative identity, not a claim of a vast commercial empire.

03 / Present activities

Independent by design.

Current work encompasses research and development, technical systems, publications, and practical tools. The Smol Model Company of New Haven operates as a distinct research initiative associated with Mathim Divisions.
